posts.title: London Fashion Week Street Style 2026 - SS27 Trends
posts.description: Every London Fashion Week feels like a reunion, but this season the show addresses disappeared from the schedule and the welcome from the veterans felt different. I've shared what I noticed shooting SS27 street style for Spotted by Pinterest, along with the trends that stood out, from purple and red to Glamoratti and colourful plaid.

posts.title: London Street Photography - Notting Hill Carnival J’Ouvert
posts.description: Notting Hill Carnival is the London event I've most wanted to photograph, but a mix-up with the dates nearly cost me another year. Then I found out about J'Ouvert, the paint-throwing parade at dawn, so after an hour's sleep I left on a Lime bike at 4:20am and came home covered in paint.

posts.title: London Street Photography - Solar Eclipse on Primrose Hill
posts.description: Some London events come around every year, but the solar eclipse on 12 August was a once-in-a-lifetime one I'd marked in my calendar months ahead. After a long client shoot nearly sent me home, I made it to Primrose Hill and spent the peak photographing the crowds in their eclipse glasses rather than looking up myself.
